column1: # Infinium array platforms, from zhou-lab/InfiniumAnnotation at the tag in TAGS.
# Two directories per platform, with separate manifests and therefore separate
# trust anchors:
#   <platform>/          ordering, mask, coord, snp, typeI_ext   (sesame + kycg)
#   <platform>/KYCG/     the knowledgebase .cm sets              (kycg)
# The ordering table lives in the platform directory, one level ABOVE KYCG/.
# kycg used to keep its own copy inside KYCG/; that is the one path that had to
# move for a single download to serve both tools.
# This table says what EXISTS upstream. Which of these platforms a given
# tool carries is that tool's decision, made in its own generator -- a
# consumption list in the producer's data is the same inversion as a
# consumer's struct in the producer's repo.
# beads   IDAT nSNPsRead, for platform auto-detection. 0 = no detect.
# rows    probes in the platform's ordering. Hand-pinned: it is a property
#         of the ordering file's contents, not of the manifest.
# The count of .cm sets is NOT here -- it is counted from the cached
# KYCG/SHA256SUMS, so it cannot drift from what the tag actually publishes.
